courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道超前探測鑽孔
related.titleEn: Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces
related.transfer: 可遷移「介電常數與波速」與「里程輪定位誤差」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道超前探測鑽孔的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Permittivity and wave speed" and "Distance wheel location error" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦校準雷達波速與定位誤差並保留地下管線判讀的不確定性；隧道超前探測鑽孔則以以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on calibrate radar velocity and location error while retaining buried utility interpretation uncertainty; Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces centres on build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「介電常數與波速」與「探測目標與盲區」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道超前探測鑽孔，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「裂隙導水與尺度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Permittivity and wave speed” and “Targets and blind zones”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fracture flow and scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 管道原位固化內襯
related.transfer: 可遷移「介電常數與波速」與「里程輪定位誤差」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；管道原位固化內襯的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Permittivity and wave speed" and "Distance wheel location error" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cured-in-place pipe lining must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦校準雷達波速與定位誤差並保留地下管線判讀的不確定性；管道原位固化內襯則以連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on calibrate radar velocity and location error while retaining buried utility interpretation uncertainty; Cured-in-place pipe lining centres on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「介電常數與波速」與「剩餘厚度判讀」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到管道原位固化內襯，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水理容量比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Permittivity and wave speed” and “Remaining thickness interpretation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cured-in-place pipe lining, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hydraulic capacity comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地下管線探地雷達探測
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立校準雷達波速與定位誤差並保留地下管線判讀的不確定性的背景。美國地質調查所發布金銀島跨孔雷達研究（2000）。研究作者公開試坑雷達與DepthNet方法（2020）。研究作者公開管線方向與半徑反演模型（2022）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for calibrate radar velocity and location error while retaining buried utility interpretation uncertainty. USGS publishes the Treasure Island crosshole radar study (2000). Authors publish test-pit radar and DepthNet research (2020). Authors publish a pipe direction and radius inversion model (2022). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
